name: Bytes

sections.heading: Logical layout
sections.text: Logical address and byte length; retain the owner lifetime for its bytes.

sections.heading: Construction and members
sections.text: Bytes.empty/fromByte/fromValues; byteLength and at. There is no separate Byte(...) constructor in this profile.

sections.heading: Protocols and ownership
sections.text: The descriptor refers to retained byte data. Derived views remain bound to the owner lifetime; release child views before their parent. Binding a descriptor does not authorize mutation or extend borrowed storage. Explicit textual/byte operations preserve their documented byte or scalar units.

sections.heading: Errors, limits and target
sections.text: Use x86_64 Linux System V ELF for the executed examples. Incompatible types reject before publication; bounds and ownership checks precede an invalid read, mutation or drop. Internal descriptor layouts are not portable ABI promises.

summary: A byte sequence with unsigned elements widened to Int on read.
